evals.prompt: I need to add user authentication (signup, login, session) to our task app. This touches the database, API, and frontend. Can you break this into a plan I can actually execute?
evals.expected_output: A dependency-ordered, vertically-sliced task list with explicit acceptance criteria and verification steps per task.
expectations: Slices work vertically (by user-facing capability) rather than horizontally by layer (all DB, then all API, then all UI)
Each task includes explicit acceptance criteria
Each task includes a verification step, not just a description
Tasks are ordered respecting dependencies (e.g. schema before API before UI)
Flags or avoids XL-sized tasks, breaking them down further
